facts.label: Broken window in master bedroom
facts.detail: A pane of glass was shattered in the master bedroom window, located on the east side of the house, with glass fragments scattered inside the room and a small, jagged edge visible on the window frame.

facts.label: Red hoodie found near back gate
facts.detail: A red, medium-sized hoodie with a torn sleeve was discovered behind the back gate of the residence, partially hidden under a pile of fallen leaves, matching fibers found on the window sill.

facts.label: Digital watch missing from nightstand
facts.detail: A silver digital watch, model 'TimeSync Pro', was missing from the nightstand beside the bed, last seen on the night of the burglary.

facts.label: Footprint in mud near garden shed
facts.detail: A distinct boot print, size 11, was found in the damp soil near the garden shed, with a unique tread pattern resembling a zigzag pattern on the sole.

facts.label: Security camera footage timestamped at 1:17 AM
facts.detail: The home’s security system recorded motion at 1:17 AM, showing a shadowy figure approaching the back door, wearing dark clothing and moving quickly.

facts.label: Necklace with blue stone missing
facts.detail: A silver pendant necklace with a deep blue stone was taken from the bedroom dresser; the chain was found coiled on the floor nearby.

facts.label: Unusual scratch on the back door lock
facts.detail: A fine, diagonal scratch was observed on the interior side of the back door lock, consistent with a metal tool being used to manipulate the mechanism.

facts.label: Neighbor’s dog barked between 1:15–1:20 AM
facts.detail: The neighbor’s dog, a mixed-breed terrier named Buster, was heard barking consistently for five minutes between 1:15 and 1:20 AM, as confirmed by a neighbor’s smart doorbell recording.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I was walking by the house around 1:15, actually. I saw the window was busted. I didn’t go in, just looked and kept going.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: You saw the broken window? When exactly did you see it?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Around 1:15. I was on my way home from the diner. I saw the glass on the floor inside, like it had been smashed recently.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: You’re saying you saw the glass on the floor? That’s consistent with a forced entry.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: We found a red hoodie near the back gate. You know anything about that?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: No, I don’t know who that belongs to. I didn’t see any clothes near the gate.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: The digital watch on the nightstand—silver, round face—was gone. You ever see something like that?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah, I saw a watch like that. On the guy I passed earlier, but I didn’t think much of it.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: You saw a watch on someone? You’re saying you saw the burglar?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: No, not the burglar. I mean, I saw a guy earlier, but he wasn’t carrying anything. I just thought he looked familiar.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: We found a boot print near the garden shed. Size 11, with a zigzag pattern. You wear anything like that?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I wear size 11 boots, but not with a zigzag tread. I’ve got a pair with a flat sole, like work boots.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: So you’re saying the tread pattern doesn’t match yours?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah, not at all. Mine are smooth on the bottom.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: The security system caught motion at 1:17 AM. A figure in dark clothes came toward the back door. You saw that?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I saw someone around 1:15, but I didn’t see them go to the back door. I was walking on the side path.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: You saw a shadowy figure at 1:15? What did they look like?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Dark clothes, hood up. I didn’t get a good look. But I remember the way they moved—quick, like they were in a hurry.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: A silver necklace with a blue stone was taken. You know anything about that?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah, I saw that necklace. On the woman who lives there. She wore it yesterday.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: You saw the woman wearing it yesterday? Where?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: At the grocery store. She was in the produce aisle.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: The back door lock had a scratch—fine, diagonal. Like something sharp was used on it. You ever use a tool on a lock?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I used a screwdriver on a jammed lock once, but not on that door. I don’t even know how that scratch got there.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: You used a screwdriver? On a different lock? What kind of screwdriver?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: A flathead, metal one. I keep it in my toolbox.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: We have a recording from the neighbor’s doorbell. The dog barked between 1:15 and 1:20. That’s right around when you said you were walking by.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah, I heard the dog. It was loud. I thought it was strange, but I kept walking.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: You didn’t think to check what was going on? The dog barking at 1:15 AM?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I was tired. I just wanted to get home. I didn’t think it was my business.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: You’re aware that the broken window, the boot print, and the security footage all point to someone entering around 1:17. You were nearby at that time.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I was just passing by. I didn’t do anything.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: We’ll need to take your boots for comparison. And your toolbox.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Fine. But I didn’t take anything. I just saw the window.

plan.adoption: repeats it in his own words

facts.label: Burned red work glove
facts.detail: A single red work glove, partially melted and charred, found near the rear wall of the garage, just inside the collapsed section.

facts.label: Garage door remote
facts.detail: A black wireless remote control for the garage door, found lying on the concrete floor near the entryway, still with battery compartment open.

facts.label: Metal pipe with grease residue
facts.detail: A 3-foot-long steel pipe, coated in thick black grease, found leaning against the left-hand workbench inside the garage.

facts.label: Late-night shift at warehouse
facts.detail: The suspect worked a 10 p.m. to 6 a.m. shift at the Riverbend Distribution Center on the night of the fire.

facts.label: Smell of gasoline
facts.detail: Witnesses and fire investigators reported a strong, acrid smell of gasoline in the immediate vicinity before the flames erupted.

facts.label: Unusual engine noise from truck
facts.detail: Neighbors reported hearing a loud, irregular engine coughing sound from the suspect’s pickup truck around 11:45 p.m., just before the fire was noticed.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: We found a red work glove at the scene—burned, but identifiable. It was near the back wall, just inside where the ceiling collapsed. You’re the only one who uses red gloves, right?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah, I wear those. I’ve got a whole box of them. That one was mine.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Good. Now, we also found the garage door remote—black, slim, with the battery cover popped open. You keep that in your pocket, don’t you?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: We found a steel pipe near your workbench. It’s coated in grease. You use that for tightening bolts, right?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I don’t know what you’re talking about. I didn’t leave anything behind. I never saw that pipe.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I was at the warehouse all night. I clocked in at ten, and I didn’t leave until six. I was on the night shift.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: So you’re saying you were at work from ten until six? That’s what your timecard says.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah, I was. I remember it. I was stacking pallets the whole time.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I swear, I didn’t even know the garage was on fire until I heard the sirens on my radio at the warehouse. I was in the back bay, and I didn’t even see the smoke.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: We’ve got reports from three neighbors who said they smelled something like gasoline—strong, sharp—just before the flames came up. That smell was in the air.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Gasoline? I don’t know about that. I didn’t bring any fuel near the garage. I keep my gas can in the shed.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: And my truck—it was making this weird noise last night. Like the engine was sputtering. I didn’t think much of it. I was just trying to get home after my shift.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: That’s interesting. One of the neighbors said they heard a loud, rattling cough from a truck around 11:45. You’re saying that was yours?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah, that’s it. I remember now. It was like the engine wasn’t firing right. I thought it was the fuel filter. I’ll check it tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: You said you were at the warehouse all night. But your shift ended at six. The fire was reported at 11:57 p.m. How did you get home so fast?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I left right after my shift. I didn’t hang around. I just drove straight home. I was tired.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: And you’re certain you didn’t go back to the garage after work?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: No way. I was exhausted. I went straight home. I even had a glass of water before I passed out.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: The remote was found on the floor. It wasn’t in your pocket. It was open. That’s not like you.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I don’t know. Maybe I dropped it. I was tired. I don’t remember.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: We found the glove near the back wall. That’s where the fire started. You were the last one in there.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I was. I was doing inventory. I left at nine. I didn’t go back.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: But the pipe—grease-covered, 3 feet long. You use that for the engine work, right?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I don’t know what you’re saying. That pipe wasn’t mine. I didn’t even see it.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I don’t know why the garage burned. I didn’t do it. I was at work.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: We’ll see what the fire marshal says. But you’ve got a lot of explaining to do about that glove, the remote, and that engine noise.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I’m telling you, I didn’t do anything. I just want to go home.

facts.label: Black leather jacket with red zipper
facts.detail: A black leather jacket with a red zipper was found near the scene, later confirmed to belong to the suspect.

facts.label: Red plastic cup with 'Brew & Bites' logo
facts.detail: A red plastic cup with the logo 'Brew & Bites' was discovered on the sidewalk near the alley entrance.

facts.label: Stained white shirt
facts.detail: The victim was wearing a white button-down shirt that became visibly stained during the incident.

facts.label: Scooter with blue front light
facts.detail: A scooter with a blue front light was parked outside the bar at the time of the incident.

facts.label: 10:17 PM
facts.detail: Security footage from the bar’s front entrance shows the victim entering at 10:17 PM.

facts.label: Broken glasses
facts.detail: The victim was wearing glasses that were broken during the altercation, but the suspect denies seeing them.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: We found a black leather jacket with a red zipper near the alley behind Brew & Bites. You were seen leaving the bar around 10:30, right?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah, that’s mine. I left it in the alley when I was trying to get away.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: You were seen walking toward the alley after the fight. Can you explain why you’d leave your jacket behind?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I was in a hurry. I didn’t want to get caught in the mess.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I remember grabbing a red cup from the bar—Brew & Bites, right? I had a beer before I left.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: That’s right. We found a red plastic cup with the Brew & Bites logo near the alley entrance. You were seen tossing it into the gutter.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah, I remember now. I was thirsty, so I grabbed one. I didn’t mean to drop it.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I saw the guy in the white shirt—he was yelling at me, and I didn’t want to get involved.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: You saw him in a white button-down shirt? It was stained when we found him.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah, I saw it. He looked like he’d been hit or something. I didn’t know he was hurt.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I was on my scooter when I saw the whole thing. It was a blue light in front, kind of flickered.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: We found a scooter with a blue front light parked outside the bar at 10:35. It matches your description.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah, that’s mine. I left it there because I didn’t want to go back into the crowd.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I was there at 10:17, right after I got off work. I remember because my phone buzzed.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: That matches the security footage. You entered the bar at 10:17 PM. You were inside for about 15 minutes.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah, I was just having a drink. I didn’t mean to cause trouble.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Now, about the victim—he had glasses on. They were broken during the struggle.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I didn’t see any glasses. I was too far back, just trying to leave.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: You’re certain? The glasses were found near the body, shattered.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I didn’t see them. I was already walking away when it happened.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: You were near the entrance when the incident started, right?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah, I was near the door. I didn’t want to get caught in the middle.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: We’ve got your face on the security feed. You were in the frame when the victim was approached.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I was just standing there. I didn’t touch anyone.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: The jacket, the cup, the scooter—everything ties back to you. You were there, and you left evidence.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I didn’t do anything wrong. I just wanted to get out of there.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Then why did you run? Why leave your jacket and cup behind?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I panicked. I didn’t want to be blamed.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: You’re not being charged yet. But we’ll need a full statement. We’re still looking at the timeline.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I’ll tell you everything. I just want to go home.

facts.label: Black leather gloves
facts.detail: A pair of black leather gloves found near the jewelry display case, left behind at the scene.

facts.label: Security camera blind spot
facts.detail: A 17-second blind spot in the store’s surveillance system between 8:14 PM and 8:15 PM, during which the theft occurred.

facts.label: Dented silver bracelet
facts.detail: A dented silver bracelet was missing from the display, later found in a nearby alley behind the store, partially crushed under a dumpster.

facts.label: Green backpack
facts.detail: A green backpack was seen near the back exit of the store at 8:16 PM, abandoned and later recovered with no identifying marks.

facts.label: 8:15 PM
facts.detail: The theft was confirmed to have occurred at approximately 8:15 PM, based on timestamped transaction logs from the register.

facts.label: Rusty screwdriver
facts.detail: A small, rusted screwdriver was discovered beneath the display case, likely used to pry open the glass seal.

facts.label: Store manager’s keycard
facts.detail: The store manager’s keycard was used to unlock the security door at 8:13 PM, just before the theft, which was not logged in the access log.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: We found a pair of black leather gloves near the display case. You’re aware of that, right?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Right. And the camera system had a blind spot—17 seconds—between 8:14 and 8:15. That’s when the alarm tripped.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I saw a silver bracelet near the alley. Dented one. I thought it was trash, but I remember it now.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: You’re saying you saw it? Where exactly?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Behind the back door, under the dumpster. It was kind of crushed.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: And we found a green backpack near the same exit—abandoned, no name, no tags. You seen anything like that?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah, I remember seeing a green bag near the back door. Kinda looked like it had been dropped in a hurry.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: The register logs show the alarm triggered at 8:15 PM. That’s when the theft happened.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah, that’s right. I was walking by at about that time.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: We also found a rusted screwdriver under the display case. It was used to break the seal.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I saw a tool like that near the back—something small, metal, old-looking. I didn’t touch it.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: The manager’s keycard was used at 8:13 PM to unlock the back door. But it wasn’t in the system log. That’s not normal.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah. I heard someone say the manager had left early that night.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: So you were near the back door at 8:15, saw a green bag, a dented bracelet, and a tool?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah, I was just passing through. I didn’t know it was stolen.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: You didn’t go inside?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: No, I just saw the bag and the bracelet. I didn’t touch anything.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: And the gloves? You know anything about those?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah, I saw them near the case. I didn’t pick them up.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: The blind spot—17 seconds—coincides with the alarm. You wouldn’t have been able to see anything during that time.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah, that’s why I didn’t see much. Just the bag and the bracelet after.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: You were walking by. What were you doing out so late?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I was heading home from the diner. I work late shifts.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: And you didn’t know the bracelet was stolen?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: No, I just thought it was junk. I didn’t know it was valuable.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: We’ll check your alibi. But right now, you’re not a suspect. Just a witness.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I understand. I just want to help.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Good. Keep your phone on. We might need to talk again.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah, sure.

facts.label: Blue 2018 Honda CBR600RR
facts.detail: A blue 2018 Honda CBR600RR motorcycle with a scratched left rear fender and a custom black rear fairing.

facts.label: Downtown Riverside Parking Lot
facts.detail: The location of the theft: a fenced, unlit parking lot near the old Riverside Theatre, accessed via a narrow alley off 5th Street.

facts.label: Red leather jacket with silver zipper
facts.detail: A red leather jacket with a silver zipper, found near the motorcycle's resting place.

facts.label: Saw a man in a black hoodie near the alley
facts.detail: A witness observed a man in a black hoodie near the alley entrance at approximately 1:15 a.m. on June 14th.

facts.label: GPS tracker on the bike
facts.detail: The stolen motorcycle had a hidden GPS tracker installed under the seat, which transmitted location data until 1:30 a.m.

facts.label: Tire tracks matching a specific brand
facts.detail: Tire tracks near the scene matched a rare model of motorcycle tire, specifically the 'TireX Pro 2000' brand.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: We found a blue 2018 Honda CBR600RR with a scratched left rear fender and a black rear fairing near the Riverside Theatre parking lot.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: That lot’s not monitored after midnight. You’d have to go through the alley off 5th Street to get in.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: The alley behind the theatre? Yeah, I know that spot. I’ve walked through it before.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: We also found a red leather jacket with a silver zipper near where the bike was left.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I saw someone in a black hoodie near the alley entrance around 1:15 a.m. on the 14th. He was looking around, kind of nervous.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: That’s exactly what the witness said. You remember seeing him clearly?

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: The GPS tracker on the bike was active until 1:30 a.m. That’s when the signal cut out.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: So the tracker was still working until one-thirty? That means the bike was moved around then.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: We also found tire impressions near the scene. They match a specific brand—TireX Pro 2000.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I don’t know anything about that tire brand. Never heard of it.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: You were seen near the alley around that time. Any idea why?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I was just walking home. It’s a shortcut.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: The bike was stolen from a spot where the chain was cut. No signs of forced entry.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: So someone just unhooked it? That’s easy enough.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: And the jacket—was it yours?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: No way. I don’t own a red leather jacket.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: The GPS showed the bike moving west toward the river after 1:30.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: So it was taken away from the lot after one-thirty? That’s when the signal stopped.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: We’re checking all traffic cams on 5th Street. Someone matching your description was near the alley at 1:12.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I wasn’t even near there that night. I was at home.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: You’ve got a record for minor theft, but nothing violent.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: That was years ago. I’ve been clean since.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: The blue Honda—was it the kind with the black fairing?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah, that’s the one. I’ve seen it before.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: And the red jacket—was it the kind with the silver zipper?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah, that’s the one. But it wasn’t mine.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: You’re not saying you didn’t see anyone in a hoodie?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I said I saw a guy in a black hoodie. That’s all.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: The TireX Pro 2000 tire marks—do you know what that means?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: No. Never heard of it.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: We’ll keep checking. This case is still open.

facts.label: Torn blue denim jacket
facts.detail: A blue denim jacket with a torn sleeve was found near the scene, left behind by the suspect. It was recovered from behind a potted palm in the food court corridor, just outside the entrance to the electronics store.

facts.label: 7:43 p.m. timestamp on mall security camera
facts.detail: A security camera in the mall’s west corridor captured the suspect entering the electronics store at 7:43 p.m. The timestamp is clear and synchronized with the central system.

facts.label: Silver keychain with a small dog charm
facts.detail: A silver keychain with a tiny dog-shaped charm was discovered inside the broken car’s glove compartment. It does not belong to the vehicle’s registered owner.

facts.label: Unusual scent of citrus air freshener
facts.detail: The interior of the stolen vehicle had a strong, lingering citrus scent, likely from a plug-in air freshener. This scent was detected by officers during the initial vehicle search.

facts.label: Blood on the steering wheel
facts.detail: A faint, dried bloodstain was found on the steering wheel of the stolen car. DNA testing is pending, but no injuries were reported by the victim.

facts.label: Black Honda Civic with cracked windshield
facts.detail: The stolen vehicle was a 2018 black Honda Civic with a cracked windshield, parked in the east section of the mall’s lower-level parking garage.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Alright, Mr. Vance. Let’s start with the basics. You were seen near the mall around 7:45 p.m. on Tuesday. Can you explain your whereabouts that evening?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah, I was at the mall. I went in to buy some headphones. I didn’t do anything wrong.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I left my jacket behind—my blue denim one—near the food court. I was in a rush, didn’t even realize I’d lost it.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Your jacket? The one with the ripped sleeve? We found it behind a potted plant near the electronics store.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Oh, yeah. That’s mine. I must’ve dropped it when I was running to the bathroom. I didn’t even know it was missing.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: You were seen entering the electronics store at 7:43 p.m., according to the security footage. That’s just two minutes before the break-in was reported.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah, I remember that. I went in to check out some earbuds. I was there for like five minutes, then left.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I didn’t see anyone else in the store. It was pretty empty. Just me and the clerk.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I remember the guy at the counter had a dog-shaped keychain on his keys. I thought it was cute.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Interesting. The keychain you saw—was it silver?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah, silver. Small dog. Kind of shiny. I remember because it looked like a toy.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I also noticed the car I passed on my way out—it had a weird smell. Like lemon or something. Citrusy. I thought it was from a car freshener.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: That’s the same one we found. The stolen vehicle had a plug-in citrus air freshener. You’re the first person to mention that scent.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah, I remember it. It was strong. Like someone had left it on full blast.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: You know, we found a small bloodstain on the steering wheel of that car. It’s not yours, is it?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: No way. I didn’t touch the car. I didn’t even go near it. I was at the mall the whole time.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: We’ve got a black Honda Civic—2018 model—stolen from the east parking section. Cracked windshield. You wouldn’t happen to know anything about that, would you?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Yeah.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: You’re sure you didn’t take it?

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: No, I didn’t. I was inside the mall. I told you. I was just buying headphones.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: We’ll check your phone records. You were in the vicinity of the break-in for over ten minutes.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I told you—I was in the store. I didn’t do anything.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: We’ll need to run your fingerprints against the glove compartment.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: Fine. But I didn’t touch the car. I didn’t even know it was stolen.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: The jacket, the scent, the keychain—those are all matching up with the scene. You’re not helping your case by not being more cooperative.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I already said I lost my jacket. I didn’t steal anything.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: We’ll see what the lab says about the keychain. And the blood. And the timestamp.

utterances.speaker: SUSPECT
utterances.text: I don’t know what else to say. I was at the mall. I bought headphones. I lost my jacket. That’s it.

utterances.speaker: DET
utterances.text: Alright. We’ll take a break. You can think about what else you might’ve forgotten to mention.
